answer: The target covers GM Operations, includes GM Financial, and excludes China joint ventures. Against a 2018 baseline of 4.3 million MTCO2e, GM targets a 72% reduction by 2035; 2025 status was 2.1 million MTCO2e, reported as 52% performance to target.
subject: General Motors
scope_boundary: GM Operations; GM Financial included; China JVs excluded and classified as Scope 3 investments
